description: Kael VARkombi-12-PC three-phase reactive power controller with RS-485 (Modbus RTU)
source: Kael Elektronik, "VARkombi-12-PC" user manual (Turkish), register table on pages 15-20, program version 0x0300
notes: All registers are 16-bit holding registers. The manual gives 9600 baud, no parity and addresses 1-255.

ATRF is the current transformer ratio (register 0x1000, e.g. 20 for 100/5 A). Per-phase currents and powers must be multiplied by ATRF as noted in each description; the scale is the table's multiplier.
Energies are 48-bit counters in watt-seconds or var-seconds, split over three registers (bits 47-32, 31-16 and 15-0).
Names and descriptions are translated from the Turkish manual.

registers.description: For 100/5 A write 20
